frame.note: Local true east/north metres at surveyed LM. Original routes use spherical Transverse Mercator (radius 1,737,400 m, central meridian 30.7°, false easting 500,000 m, scale factor 1). Subtract the projected LM and rotate by local grid convergence. Decimal precision preserves source coordinates; it does not imply millimetre accuracy.

source.datum: Heights above the 1,737,400 m lunar reference sphere; LOLA-tied.
source.confidenceSource: Original PDS IMG classes; contrast-stretched browse TIFFs are not used.
source.confidenceRule: All four bilinear contributors must have documented classes 10–15 to count as trusted; any unknown class is retained as untrusted.

limitations: 4 m bilinear resampling and decimetre quantization are prototype processing, not 4 m survey accuracy.
Published low-confidence elevations remain marked where neither source has a reliable alternative.
17 isolated context nodes retain a bounded local plane from measured neighbours (18 fill attempts; interior overlap is replaced by the canonical field); no ride-field gap is filled this way.
Source surface is rendered in a local map plane; no lunar-curvature correction is applied.
No procedural hills, rocks or fabricated elevation substitute is included.
